newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer sees single-digit H2 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer sees single-digit H2 earnings growth.

text.p: Pfizer Inc said on Friday that it expects its earnings for the second half of 1997 to grow in single digits over last year's second half.

An analyst at a Pfizer presentation pointed to Pfizer executive vice president Henry McKinnell that the company was projecting an earnings increase in the 10-percent range for the year. Earnings growth for the 1997 second quarter was 13 percent and 14 percent for the first half of the year.
McKinnell was asked if that implied that earnings growth for the second half would be in the single digits. He replied: "Yes."

McKinnell noted that the company was boosting its research and development expenses to $2.0 billion for the year from $1.7 billion last year to ramp up trials of the wave of new products expected in the next few years.
